method: Template review at 16, 24, 32 and 40 CSS px. Visual judgements, not measured player error rates.

template.silhouette: One upright tied bundle, broad oval head and narrow tied waist; wheat and fish keep the same bundle envelope.
template.framing: Centred in a square. Painted bounds fit 86% of the longest dimension; equal 7% minimum padding.
template.light: Warm upper-left key, cool lower-right shade. No glow or shadow outside the object.
template.outline: One dark outer edge, about one screen pixel at 16 px. Use edge contrast rather than fine strokes.
template.value: Three large value masses: dark 15–25%, body 40–65%, highlight 80–95%. These are painting targets.
template.palette: One dominant material hue per resource, plus neutral shadows and highlights. One defining feature survives the small size.
template.detail: At 16 px: silhouette, three value masses, one defining feature. No speckles, lettering, hairline veins or detached particles.
template.fit: Same 86% painted extent in the ring and chip. Never shrink a busy image to make it fit.
